verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say voicemail is transcribed ('Voicemail with transcriptions', 'Read voicemail-to-text', 'read as texts') and readable in the app. The vendor's porting blog describes voicemail-to-email that delivers audio files and transcripts to your inbox without logging into the voicemail box. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party documentation of voicemail-to-email (it appears only in a porting blog post), clarity on which plans include email delivery versus in-app text, any chat-tool delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
